description: Details required by condition 3(a, c, part of e, f, g, h)(submission of details - a) new timber framed orangery infill, including a section at 1:20 and colour/finish; c) sample of new York stone for external rear steps and paving; e) new internal double doors at ground/first floor level and new upper ground floor door and adjacent partition to the basement staircase at 1:10, including a section; f) new internal hard flooring, including a sample and a section at 1:20. The section should indicate the retention of historic floorboards where relevant; g) new cornicing, including a section at 1:10; h) height and form of new built in joinery to rear main room at first floor level;) of listed building consent 25/00576 (Replacement glazed infill extension; reduction of rear lightwell including installation of grill over remaining lightwell; removal of unauthorised store; alterations to fenestration and internal alterations to all floors.)
